system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

Your training with the secrets of the Hyuga has allotted you a plethora of abilities that help shape your technique and fighting style. Select 2 Hyuga Dogma’s which exemplify your skill within the clan. You gain one additional choice at 11th level.

Combat Insight

You gain amazing combat senses with or without your Byakugan. As a bonus action, while observing a creature, you can make an Identify (Ninjutsu, Genjutsu or Taijutsu/Bukijutsu, pick one) check against a creature you can see, vs their Level DC. On a success, you are able to learn of any one special action or ability they have that would qualify as or is similar to, the associated check.

Wisdom of the Court

The Hyuga are not jutsu warriors or martial artists. They are the Land of Fires most premier shinobi royalty. With this status comes the wisdom of managing such social circles. You can use Wisdom in place of Charisma for Persuasion and Intimidation checks.

Predictive Perception

Your ability to intuit danger, has been honed to near perfection. When a creature would make an attack against you at advantage, you can spend your reaction making them instead roll at disadvantage and gaining a rank of Mastery to your AC for the attack.

Sensory Type

As an Action, while exploring with your Byakugan active, you can perform a Perimeter Sweep ability. When you do, for the next 10 minutes, you and allied creatures with you, gain a rank of mastery to the next saving throw made against a triggered trap.

Cold Calculations

The clan has taught you to be practical, cold and calculative in all things. When you complete a long rest, you gain the Cold Calculus special action.

Cold Calculus. This special action can be used in place of your normal action or reaction for any Hyuga Hijutsu that requires it. Once this special action has been used, you cannot regain it until you complete a long rest.

Illusion Fist

A little-known secret of the Byakugan is that, when Genjutsu is focused through it, it becomes more focused, light sunlight though a magnifying glass. While in the Gentle Fist Stance, you can choose to make melee Genjutsu attacks, in place of unarmed attacks. These attacks, deal psychic damage when made this way.

Additionally, if you cast a Hyuga Hijutsu with Wisdom, you can change its damage type to Psychic, but counts as chakra or necrotic for other Hyuga clan features.

Tenketsu Needle

Once per turn, when you deal chakra damage to a creature with ranks of Sealed or Network Distortion, increase the chakra damage dealt by +2. This increases to +4 at 11th level.
